التحقتما (form VIII)
# اِلْتَحَقْتُمَا (iltaḥaqtumā) /il.ta.ħaq.tu.maː/: second-person dual past active of اِلْتَحَقَ (iltaḥaqa)
# اُلْتُحِقْتُمَا (ultuḥiqtumā) /ul.tu.ħiq.tu.maː/: second-person dual past passive of اِلْتَحَقَ (iltaḥaqa)
